keys.visit: \bvisit|just (came|come|here) to (talk|see you|say hello)|keep you company|not here to (fight|kill|hurt)

lines.opener: *a bellow echoes down the corridors; then a bull's head on a man's huge body rounds the corner, snorting* Visitor. Visitor? Are you the tribute? You don't look like the tribute.
lines.openerHostile: *he lowers his horns and paws the stone floor* Another one. Another one come to kill me. Come, then. COME.
lines.like: *he snorts softly and paws the ground* ...Yes. Yes. Say more. Say more.
lines.dislike: *the great head swings low* Don't. Don't call me that. Don't.
lines.hate: *a bellow that shakes dust from the walls* THESEUS?! *the horns come down and he charges*
lines.flirt: *a long, slow snort; he tosses his horns and gives you a heavy, deliberate wink* ...Strong, am I? Come closer and say that, visitor.
lines.join: *he stares at you for a long moment, breathing hard* Take me with you. Take me out. I want to see. I want to see it.
lines.demand: *he squares up to you, horns low but playful* Wrestle me. Once. Just once. Nobody ever wrestles me.
lines.gift: *he drags something out of a dark corner and drops it at your feet* Someone left it. Long ago. You take it.
lines.thanks: *he snorts, pleased, and shakes his head* Good. Good. That was good.
lines.letPass: *he steps back into a side passage* Go. Left, then left, then right. Go. Come back. Maybe.
lines.neutral: *he circles you slowly, counting under his breath* ...left, and left...
lines.ai: *he cocks his huge head* A... what? Is that a kind of Athenian? Speak plain, visitor.
lines.refuseJoin: *he backs away, snorting* No. No. Don't ask. I said don't ask.
lines.leaveNow: *he turns and lumbers off into the dark* I was saying. I was saying... never mind.
